G123.name: Simulation Group
G123.desc: This is a group about creating simulations of human behaviour. Please keep all content strictly regarding how to best simulate irrationality.

P12345.title: Aaru's doing it wrong
P12345.content: Aaru has a thesis that human behaviour can be simulated, and i disagree. I think you can have systems that act similar to how a human would act, but never prediction.

R123456.content: You're totally wrong, what differentiates similarity in such a way where it can't bear representative weight of how people would act?
